server.description: HTTP service and hardware device settings.

port.description: TCP port used by the HTTP API service.

devices.description: Comma-separated device IDs available to this service instance.

rk_perf.description: Enable RK3588 CPU affinity and TCIM synchronization optimizations.

rk_perf_cores.description: Comma-separated RK3588 Cortex-A76 CPU core IDs used when rk_perf is enabled.

replicas.description: Legacy total process instance count; use replica.count for new configurations.

memory_saving.description: Legacy worker delayed-loading switch; use replica.memory_saving for new configurations.

proxy.description: Timeouts for HTTP forwarding from the master service to model subprocesses.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to connect to a local model subprocess, clamped to 100-10000 ms.

non_stream_read_timeout_sec.description: Idle read timeout for non-streaming model responses, clamped to 60-3600 seconds.

stream_idle_timeout_sec.description: Maximum interval without response bytes for streaming requests, clamped to 10-600 seconds.

write_timeout_sec.description: Timeout for writing a request to a model subprocess, clamped to 5-300 seconds.

max_request_timeout_sec.description: Absolute upper bound for a proxied request, clamped to 300-7200 seconds.

count.description: Total hi.cpp process instances, including the master instance.

device_policy.description: Policy used to assign devices to replica processes.

max_instances_per_device.description: Maximum process instances assigned to one device unless exclusive_card is selected.

memory_saving.description: Delay worker model loading to reduce peak startup memory use.

startup_delay_sec.description: Per-instance startup delay in seconds when memory_saving is enabled.

balancer.description: External management service and load balancer registration settings.

enabled.description: Register this service instance with the external management service.

management_url.description: Base URL of the external management service.

target_host.description: Host address advertised by this instance to the management service.

heartbeat_interval_ms.description: Heartbeat interval to the management service in milliseconds.

retention_days.description: Number of calendar-day log directories retained, including today.

max_files.description: Legacy maximum number of rotated log files.

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size of each application and TCIM log part in MiB.

location.description: Directory used to store application log files.

open_console_window.description: Open a console window when running the Windows SDK or demo application.

llm_params.description: Command-line options passed through to llama-server.

--jinja.description: Enable llama-server Jinja chat template processing when the option is present.

--reasoning-format.description: Reasoning content extraction format used by llama-server.

model.description: Model discovery, loading, and runtime residency settings.

cur_model.description: Root directory scanned for model files.

default.description: Default LLM or Whisper model name without its file extension.

default_mmproj.description: Default multimodal projector model name without its file extension.

enable_sd3.description: Load the configured Stable Diffusion 3 model by default.

auto_load.description: Automatically load the model requested by completion or embedding APIs.

discovery_scan_interval_sec.description: Interval in seconds for detecting newly downloaded models; 0 disables periodic discovery.

discovery_stability_sec.description: Time a changed model directory must remain unchanged before new GGUF files are validated and registered.

discovery_scan_on_models_request.description: Wake the background discovery worker when listing models or resolving an unknown requested model.

discovery_request_wait_sec.description: Maximum seconds an on-demand model lookup waits for discovery registration; 0 disables waiting.

auto_unload.description: Allow idle models to be evicted by memory, count, or idle-time policies.

idle_ttl_sec.description: Idle time in seconds before a model may be evicted; 0 disables TTL eviction.

max_loaded_models.description: Maximum concurrently loaded models; 0 means unlimited.

pinned_models.description: Comma-separated model identifiers protected from automatic eviction.

llm_lazy_mode.description: Enable lazy loading for LLM models.

llm_presets_enabled.description: Enable per-model llama.cpp preset and local override resolution.

llm_preset_catalog.description: Path to the versioned official per-model llama.cpp preset catalog.

llm_override_catalog.description: Path to the deployment-local per-model llama.cpp override catalog.

llm_preset_strict.description: Fail initialization when an existing llama.cpp preset catalog is invalid.
